section.sectionSummaryBrief: Through Torah study in the manner of "that you shall place before them," including the acquisition of a servant, one merits the revelation of Moshiach's new Torah in the true and complete redemption.
section.t: And through the study of Torah in the manner of "that you shall place before them,"
that the study is with understanding and reasoning, and together with this, with the self-nullification of a servant
[so that the study of the revealed Torah will be in this manner, it is through the study of the inner dimension of Torah,
"tashim" (you shall place) — a term for "simah" (a treasure),
through this they will merit the revelation of the Torah of Moshiach,
"a new Torah shall go forth from Me,"
in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,
